items: Continuous-compliance expectations replace annual snapshots; tokenization and segmentation evidence is assembled manually.
Issuer, acquirer, wallet and scheme data reconcile in nightly files; dispute and fraud analytics lag events.
Decline models tuned for fraud miss consumer context; good customers fail at checkout silently.
Fraud and risk enrichment adds milliseconds that cost approval rates; batch components cannot sit on the instant path.
